content_units: You are well-positioned for   entry-to-mid corporate L&D roles   in Dublin, especially roles that value   facilitation, curriculum design, LMS ownership, and stakeholder management   over deep analytics or advanced eLearning production.

Best-fit target:   Learning & Development Specialist / Coordinator / Trainer / Instructional Designer (light-authoring focus)   in the   €50,000–€60,000   range, with strongest odds in larger corporates, tech, financial services, healthcare, and outsourced training functions.
Best-Fit Role Titles and Gap Map
Role Title   Fit for Your Background   Typical Dublin Salary Fit   Main Skill Gaps to Close   Why It’s a Strong Search Target
Learning & Development Specialist   High   €45k–€60k   learning analytics; business KPI alignment   Strong match for facilitation, program delivery, stakeholder comms
Learning & Development Coordinator   High   €40k–€52k   reporting; vendor/process exposure   Easiest transition point; often values organization and LMS admin
Corporate Trainer   High   €45k–€58k   business acumen; onboarding/sales enablement context   Direct carryover from classroom teaching and facilitation
Instructional Designer   Medium-High   €50k–€65k   Storyline/Captivate; needs analysis; xAPI/authoring depth   Good fit if you strengthen tool stack beyond Rise
Learning Experience Designer   Medium   €50k–€65k   UX mindset; authoring depth; analytics   Attractive title in tech firms, but usually asks for broader toolkit
LMS Administrator / Learning Systems Specialist   Medium-High   €45k–€60k   system reporting; integrations; compliance workflows   Good option if your LMS experience is substantial and hands-on

Days 1–30   Reposition your teaching experience for corporate L&D   Rewrite CV in business language; map classroom outcomes to business outcomes; learn Kirkpatrick basics; practice Excel essentials: pivot tables, XLOOKUP, charts; study ADDIE and needs analysis   Updated CV, LinkedIn, and 2 tailored achievement stories

Days 31–60   Close your biggest credibility gaps   Learn Articulate Storyline basics; build 1 short compliance module and 1 onboarding module; create simple learning metrics dashboard in Excel; learn SME interview and training intake methods   Small portfolio with 2 modules + 1 reporting sample

Days 61–90   Become interview-ready for €50k–€60k roles   Create case-study portfolio page; practice answers on stakeholder management, measuring impact, and prioritization; tailor applications to 15–20 roles; build examples of facilitator guides and evaluation forms   Job-ready portfolio, interview bank, and targeted application set
Likely Skill Gaps to Close First
- Most corporate L&D teams want evidence of impact, not just delivery quality.
- how to present insights to managers
- Rise is useful, but many jobs prefer   Storyline   or similar tools.
- In business settings, training is expected to solve a measurable problem.
- separating training issues from process/management issues
- You likely already have the skill; the gap is   translation  .
- Many career changers lose out because they describe skills but do not show artifacts.
Recommended Positioning for Your Salary Target
-   Instructional Designer   if you can show a portfolio within 60–90 days
-   LMS Administrator / Learning Systems Specialist   if your system experience is strong
-   L&D Coordinator   is often easier to land quickly, but may come in below your target unless the employer is a larger Dublin-based multinational.
